correctness.rationale: For squarefree n the first cyclotomic coefficient is a 2-adic unit, making Phi_n+1 an exact isometry on the even 2-adic coset. Hensel's lemma gives a unique root, and the standard identity Phi_{nq}(X)=Phi_n(X^q)/Phi_n(X) proves that toggling q changes that root by exact valuation q. The symmetric-difference formula and residue-tree consequences follow rigorously; exact modular checks support the proof.

originality.rationale: The inspected recent prime-extractor preprint proves the base-2 least-prime valuation but does not state the Hensel-root parametrization, one-prime toggle law, full prime-support isometry, or prime-controlled residue tree. Searches for exact and synonymous 2-adic cyclotomic-root formulations did not identify prior coverage.

value.rationale: The theorem upgrades a least-prime feature at one integer base to an exact 2-adic encoding of the complete squarefree prime support, with a full even-base valuation formula, an uncountable prime-controlled Cantor image, exact residue complexity 2^{pi(B-1)}, and a limiting prime-sequence constant.
